description: This source file contains shell script code used for testing git blob and diff operations, including creating blobs, comparing hashes, and verifying diff outputs.

methods.name: run_diff
methods.description: Executes git diff with full-index option between provided arguments and writes output to diff file.

methods.name: check_index
methods.description: Checks if the diff output contains the expected index line for given sha1 hashes.

methods.name: check_mode
methods.description: Checks if the diff output shows the expected old and new mode changes.

methods.name: check_paths
methods.description: Checks if the diff output contains the expected file path differences.
